## What problem does this solve?

Describe the actual use case — not just the feature, but what you're trying to accomplish that
AllieMinate can't currently do.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. If you have a specific UX or API shape in mind, describe it — but the
problem statement above matters more than the exact mechanism.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're currently using, or other approaches that could solve the same problem.

## Platform(s) this applies to

- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] Android
- [ ] All platforms / backend

## Additional context

Anything else — mockups, links to similar features in other tools, etc.
